en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Improved reference lines in the compact trend display: clearer neutral strokes, longer ends and foreground layering. Existing dimensions and color themes are preserved. Please compare overlapping lines and both reference styles on the island and lock screen.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 优化小型趋势图的参考线：提高线条辨识度、延长两端，并置于曲线上层；保留现有尺寸与配色。请核对两种参考样式在灵动岛、锁屏及线条重叠时的显示。
